authority.purpose: bibliographic evidence routing; not scientific claim promotion

classification_rules.PAIR_A: >=2 distinct independence groups, exact-formula relevance, explicit false-positive/systematics controls; does not itself promote a claim
classification_rules.PAIR_B: >=2 author groups but materially shared data/pipeline/systematics; weaker than PAIR_A
classification_rules.CLASS_MATCH: literature tests a physical/model class only; cannot close an exact-formula gate
classification_rules.CONTRADICTED_EXTERNAL_2PLUS: >=2 sufficiently independent observational paths contradict the exact prediction under the declared interpretation
classification_rules.TOKEN_VAZIO_EXACT_TEST: exact expression has no frozen, executable test against the cited observables
classification_rules.MALFORMED: mathematical, type, normalization or dimensional contradiction precedes observational fitting
classification_rules.REJECTED_NON_FALSIFIABLE: no observable falsifier can be stated

formula_states.interpretation: sigma8 is the conventional matter-clustering amplitude normalized by sigma8_0 at z=0
formula_states.falsifier: Any robust non-zero sigma8 at z=0 or nearby epochs contradicts the expression's sigma8(0)=0 normalization; sign behavior for z>0 must also remain physically admissible.
uncertainties: The state applies only to the written conventional-sigma8 interpretation; a redefined observable requires a new formula/version ID.
formula_states.next_test: Freeze a successor growth law under a new ID and compare it in the same growth likelihood; never overwrite H15.

formula_states.interpretation: N_eff is the conventional effective number of relativistic species used in CMB/BBN cosmology
formula_states.falsifier: Independent CMB and/or BBN constraints excluding N_eff~=4.86 under the same conventional definition.
uncertainties: If H21 intended a quantity other than conventional cosmological N_eff, that alternative quantity must be defined and receives a new version.
formula_states.next_test: No fit promotion. Preserve contradiction and derive any successor from an explicit particle/radiation mechanism before retesting.

formula_states.interpretation: secular fractional time variation of Newton's gravitational constant
formula_states.falsifier: Local and strong-field bounds on |Gdot/G| substantially below the predicted magnitude, using independent physical systems.
uncertainties: Exact numeric prediction depends on the H0 value and unit conversion, but the predicted order remains around 1e-11/yr for standard H0.
formula_states.next_test: If a scale-dependent G is intended, define G(t,x,environment) and a screening mechanism under a new ID; H25 remains append-only.

formula_states.interpretation: written as a real auto-power-spectrum-like quantity
formula_states.falsifier: A real auto-power spectrum must be non-negative; exp(pi i)=-1 makes the written positive-amplitude spectrum negative.
uncertainties: A complex mode amplitude can contain a phase; that would be a different object and needs a new typed expression before |.|^2.
formula_states.next_test: Type the object as amplitude versus power; create a successor ID rather than repairing H35 in place.

non_regression_rules: Evidence events are append-only; adverse, contradictory, null and uncertain edges are never deleted to improve appearance.
A new edge may increase provenance and coverage while decreasing support; coverage is not a truth score.
Bibliography/reference count must never be used directly as scientific evidence strength.
PAIR_A requires at least two distinct independence groups and explicit false-positive/systematics controls.
A superseded or repaired formula receives a new ID/version; failed historical expressions remain addressable.
TOKEN_VAZIO closure requires explicit evidence/receipt and preserves the former gap as history.
Shared datasets/pipelines/systematics reduce independence and may cap a relation at PAIR_B.
No graph state changes claim_allowed=false or publication_effect=NONE.
Negative scientific results and model collapse to a null limit are first-class evidence, not regressions.
